description: This file defines a Python class 'HeaderFileParser' that parses C++ header files to extract methods, properties, enums, structs, and iterators. It generates request and response JSON examples for methods and manages symbol information, including descriptions and examples. It also links methods to events and logs missing or unassociated components.

classes.name: HeaderFileParser
classes.description: A parser class for extracting and processing components from C++ header files, including methods, structs, enums, and generating JSON request/response examples.

methods.name: parse_header_file
methods.description: Parses the header file line-by-line to identify and record components such as methods, enums, structs, and iterators.

methods.name: match_line_with_regex
methods.description: Matches a line against a list of regex patterns to identify its type and extract groups.

methods.name: process_method
methods.description: Processes a line within a method definition, accumulating lines until the method signature is complete, then registers the method.

methods.name: process_enum
methods.description: Processes lines within an enum definition, accumulating enum members and registering the enum.

methods.name: process_struct
methods.description: Processes lines within a struct definition, accumulating members and registering the struct.

methods.name: update_doxy_tags
methods.description: Updates doxygen tag information based on matched groups from comment lines.

methods.name: register_iterator
methods.description: Registers an iterator type based on regex matches.

methods.name: register_enum
methods.description: Registers an enum and its members from a matched enum string.

methods.name: register_struct
methods.description: Registers a struct and its members, including type and description.

methods.name: register_method
methods.description: Registers a method, property, or event based on its signature and doxygen tags.

methods.name: build_method_info
methods.description: Constructs a method information dictionary, including parameters and results.

methods.name: process_and_register_params
methods.description: Extracts parameter info from declaration string and registers symbols.

methods.name: get_info_from_param_declaration
methods.description: Parses parameter declaration string into structured info.

methods.name: register_symbol
methods.description: Adds symbol info to the symbols registry, including type, description, and example.

methods.name: external_struct_tracker
methods.description: Tracks scope of external structs and updates scope stack accordingly.

methods.name: generate_request_response_objects
methods.description: Creates JSON request and response examples for methods, properties, and events.

methods.name: to_camel_case
methods.description: Converts UpperCamelCase to lowerCamelCase.

methods.name: generate_request_object
methods.description: Generates a JSON request object for a method, including example parameters.

methods.name: generate_response_object
methods.description: Generates a JSON response object for a method, including example results.

methods.name: get_symbol_example
methods.description: Retrieves an example value for a symbol, either from description or registry.

methods.name: generate_missing_examples_for_symbol_registry
methods.description: Fills in missing examples for symbols in the registry.

methods.name: generate_example_for_individual_symbol
methods.description: Creates an example value for a symbol based on description or type.

methods.name: generate_example_from_description
methods.description: Extracts an example value from a description string.

methods.name: generate_example_from_symbol_type
methods.description: Creates an example based on symbol type, including structs, enums, and basic types.

methods.name: wrap_example_if_iterator
methods.description: Wraps example in list if symbol is an iterator type.

methods.name: link_method_to_event
methods.description: Associates methods with their corresponding events.

methods.name: log_unassociated_events
methods.description: Logs events that are not linked to any method.

methods.name: fill_and_log_missing_symbol_descriptions
methods.description: Fills missing descriptions for parameters, results, and symbols, and logs missing info.

methods.name: log_missing_method_info
methods.description: Logs methods, events, or symbols with missing descriptions or examples.

methods.name: sanitize_resolution_operator_from_type
methods.description: Removes namespace resolution from type names.

methods.name: count_parentheses
methods.description: Counts parentheses in a line.

methods.name: count_braces
methods.description: Counts braces in a line.

methods.name: sort_dict
methods.description: Sorts a dictionary by keys.

methods.name: generate_flattened_descriptions_for_symbol_registry
methods.description: Creates flattened descriptions for all symbols for easier access.

methods.name: get_description_from_individual_symbol
methods.description: Retrieves flattened description for a symbol, including nested structs.

methods.name: flatten_description
methods.description: Recursively flattens struct members into dot notation descriptions.

methods.name: clean_description
methods.description: Removes doxygen tags and formatting from descriptions.
